claims.description: Content-box and border-box sizing determine how authored dimensions include padding and borders.
Physical and logical preferred dimensions resolve fixed, percentage, and intrinsic sizes.

notes.text: declaration-cascade verifies that font-relative dimensions resolve after cascaded font size regardless of declaration order. Sharing containing-block definiteness across layout passes remains pending.
Mixed percentage-and-length calculations are resolved to pixels before entering Taffy when the containing-block axis is definite.

Taffy 0.14 probes fit-content text with a definite available width. Text measurement clamps that width between minimum and maximum content widths instead of returning the longest wrapped line advance.

claims.description: Physical and logical minimum and maximum constraints bound computed sizes.

notes.text: Mixed percentage-and-length constraints are resolved to pixels before entering Taffy when the containing-block axis is definite.
Intrinsic keywords in minimum and maximum dimension constraints remain unsupported.

claims.description: Preferred aspect ratios affect either axis and interact with supported size constraints.

notes.text: Complex intrinsic sizing interactions outside the supported dimension subset are not modeled.

An authored numeric ratio overrides image, SVG, and canvas natural ratios. Image attribute ratio hints yield to the loaded natural ratio; SVG viewBox and canvas bitmap dimensions supply intrinsic ratios for auto sizing.

claims.description: scrollWidth and scrollHeight expose cached padding-box and scrollable content dimensions.

notes.text: Scroll sizes are accumulated once per layout snapshot, including text and generated boxes, child margins, trailing scroll-container padding, and supported transforms. Nested clipping and escaping absolute/fixed descendants do not inflate the container. Getter results are integer CSS pixels and remain stable after scrolling.

Uses the existing synthetic html/body model and supported inline layout subset. Native-control internals, transform-created containing blocks, writing modes and RTL scroll origins remain outside this claim.
